notes: Data-driven UE macro semantics for the syntax layer. 'match' is an exact name or a prefix ending in '*'; the first matching entry wins.

macroDocs.UCLASS: Marks a class as a UObject class for the reflection system (UHT). Needs GENERATED_BODY() and the .generated.h include.
macroDocs.USTRUCT: Marks a struct for the reflection system (UHT). Needs GENERATED_BODY().
macroDocs.UENUM: Marks an enum for the reflection system (UHT); use 'enum class E : uint8' for Blueprint types.
macroDocs.UINTERFACE: Declares the UObject side (UFoo) of an interface; the native side is IFoo with GENERATED_BODY().
macroDocs.UFUNCTION: Exposes a member function to the reflection system: Blueprints, RPCs, console commands, timers and delegates.
macroDocs.UPROPERTY: Exposes a member variable to the reflection system: garbage collection, serialization, Details panel, Blueprints and replication.
macroDocs.UMETA: Metadata of an enum value (DisplayName, Hidden, ToolTip).
macroDocs.UPARAM: Specifiers of a UFUNCTION parameter (ref, DisplayName).
macroDocs.UDELEGATE: Metadata of a dynamic delegate signature.
macroDocs.GENERATED_BODY: Injects the UHT-generated boilerplate: StaticClass(), Super, ThisClass, constructors and reflection glue.
macroDocs.GENERATED_UCLASS_BODY: Legacy GENERATED_BODY that also declares the FObjectInitializer constructor and switches to public access.
macroDocs.UE_LOG: UE_LOG(Category, Verbosity, TEXT("Format"), ...): writes a formatted message to the log.
macroDocs.check: check(Expr): asserts in non-shipping builds; the expression is not evaluated in shipping.
macroDocs.ensure: ensure(Expr): reports (once) a non-fatal assertion and returns the value of Expr.

UCLASS.name: Abstract
UCLASS.doc: Class cannot be instantiated; only subclasses can be placed or spawned.
UCLASS.zh: 抽象类，不能实例化，只能放置或生成它的子类。

UCLASS.name: AdvancedClassDisplay
UCLASS.doc: Shows all properties of the class in the Advanced section of the Details panel.
UCLASS.zh: 类的所有属性都显示在细节面板的“高级”区。

UCLASS.name: AutoCollapseCategories
UCLASS.doc: Lists categories to auto-collapse in the Details panel.
UCLASS.zh: 细节面板里自动折叠列出的分类。

UCLASS.name: AutoExpandCategories
UCLASS.doc: Lists categories to auto-expand in the Details panel.
UCLASS.zh: 细节面板里自动展开列出的分类。

UCLASS.name: Blueprintable
UCLASS.doc: Class can be used as a base class for Blueprints.
UCLASS.zh: 可以作为蓝图的父类。

UCLASS.name: BlueprintType
UCLASS.doc: Class can be used as a variable type in Blueprints.
UCLASS.zh: 可以在蓝图里作为变量类型。

UCLASS.name: ClassGroup
UCLASS.doc: Groups the class in the editor's Add Component list.
UCLASS.zh: 在编辑器“添加组件”列表里的分组。

UCLASS.name: CollapseCategories
UCLASS.doc: Properties of this class are not grouped by category in the Details panel.
UCLASS.zh: 细节面板里不按分类分组显示属性。

UCLASS.name: Config
UCLASS.doc: Class may store properties in the given .ini config file (UPROPERTY(Config)).
UCLASS.zh: 类可以把属性存到指定的 .ini 配置文件（配合 UPROPERTY(Config)）。

UCLASS.name: Const
UCLASS.doc: All properties and functions of the class are const and exported as const.
UCLASS.zh: 类的所有属性和函数都是 const，导出时也是 const。

UCLASS.name: ConversionRoot
UCLASS.doc: Root class for actor conversion in the Level Editor.
UCLASS.zh: 关卡编辑器里做 Actor 转换时的根类。

UCLASS.name: CustomConstructor
UCLASS.doc: UHT does not generate a default constructor declaration.
UCLASS.zh: UHT 不生成默认构造函数声明。

UCLASS.name: DefaultConfig
UCLASS.doc: Saves config properties to the Default*.ini instead of the user ini.
UCLASS.zh: 配置属性存到 Default*.ini，而不是用户 ini。

UCLASS.name: DefaultToInstanced
UCLASS.doc: Instances of this class are instanced by default (UPROPERTY(Instanced)).
UCLASS.zh: 这个类的对象默认按实例化处理（UPROPERTY(Instanced)）。

UCLASS.name: DependsOn
UCLASS.doc: UHT compiles the listed classes first.
UCLASS.zh: UHT 先编译列出的类。

UCLASS.name: Deprecated
UCLASS.doc: Class is deprecated; objects are not saved.
UCLASS.zh: 类已弃用，对象不会被保存。

UCLASS.name: DontAutoCollapseCategories
UCLASS.doc: Cancels AutoCollapseCategories of the parent for the listed categories.
UCLASS.zh: 对列出的分类取消父类的 AutoCollapseCategories。

UCLASS.name: DontCollapseCategories
UCLASS.doc: Cancels CollapseCategories inherited from a parent.
UCLASS.zh: 取消从父类继承的 CollapseCategories。

UCLASS.name: EditInlineNew
UCLASS.doc: Objects of this class can be created inline from the Property window.
UCLASS.zh: 可以在属性窗口里内联新建这个类的对象。

UCLASS.name: EditorConfig
UCLASS.doc: Saves editor-only config to the given editor config file.
UCLASS.zh: 编辑器专用配置存到指定的编辑器配置文件。

UCLASS.name: GlobalUserConfig
UCLASS.doc: Config properties are stored in the global user ini (per machine).
UCLASS.zh: 配置属性存到全局用户 ini（按机器）。

UCLASS.name: HideCategories
UCLASS.doc: Hides the listed categories in the Details panel.
UCLASS.zh: 细节面板里隐藏列出的分类。

UCLASS.name: HideDropdown
UCLASS.doc: Class does not appear in class picker drop-downs.
UCLASS.zh: 类不出现在类选择下拉列表里。

UCLASS.name: HideFunctions
UCLASS.doc: Hides the listed functions from the Details panel.
UCLASS.zh: 细节面板里隐藏列出的函数。

UCLASS.name: Intrinsic
UCLASS.doc: Class is declared directly in C++ with no UHT-generated boilerplate.
UCLASS.zh: 类直接用 C++ 声明，UHT 不生成样板代码。

UCLASS.name: MinimalAPI
UCLASS.doc: Exports only the type information (casts work) but not the functions from the module.
UCLASS.zh: 只导出类型信息（Cast 可用），不导出函数。

UCLASS.name: NoExport
UCLASS.doc: UHT does not generate the C++ declaration of the class.
UCLASS.zh: UHT 不生成这个类的 C++ 声明。

UCLASS.name: NonTransient
UCLASS.doc: Cancels Transient inherited from a parent class.
UCLASS.zh: 取消从父类继承的 Transient。

UCLASS.name: NotBlueprintable
UCLASS.doc: Class cannot be a base class for Blueprints.
UCLASS.zh: 不能作为蓝图的父类。

UCLASS.name: NotBlueprintType
UCLASS.doc: Class cannot be used as a Blueprint variable type.
UCLASS.zh: 不能在蓝图里作为变量类型。

UCLASS.name: NotEditInlineNew
UCLASS.doc: Objects cannot be created inline in the Property window.
UCLASS.zh: 不能在属性窗口里内联新建对象。

UCLASS.name: NotPlaceable
UCLASS.doc: Class cannot be placed in a level.
UCLASS.zh: 不能放置到关卡里。

UCLASS.name: PerObjectConfig
UCLASS.doc: Config is stored per object instance (section per object name).
UCLASS.zh: 配置按对象实例存储（每个对象名一个节）。

UCLASS.name: Placeable
UCLASS.doc: Class can be placed in a level (cancels NotPlaceable).
UCLASS.zh: 可以放置到关卡里（取消 NotPlaceable）。

UCLASS.name: ProjectUserConfig
UCLASS.doc: Config properties are stored in the project user ini.
UCLASS.zh: 配置属性存到项目用户 ini。

UCLASS.name: ShowCategories
UCLASS.doc: Shows the listed categories hidden by a parent class.
UCLASS.zh: 显示父类隐藏的那些分类。

UCLASS.name: ShowFunctions
UCLASS.doc: Shows functions hidden by a parent class.
UCLASS.zh: 显示父类隐藏的那些函数。

UCLASS.name: SparseClassDataType
UCLASS.doc: Struct type holding sparse class data.
UCLASS.zh: 存放稀疏类数据的结构体类型。

UCLASS.name: Transient
UCLASS.doc: Objects of this class are never saved to disk.
UCLASS.zh: 这个类的对象永远不保存到磁盘。

UCLASS.name: Within
UCLASS.doc: Objects can only exist inside an outer object of the given class.
UCLASS.zh: 对象只能存在于指定类的 Outer 对象里。

UCLASS.name: meta
UCLASS.doc: Metadata for the editor and Blueprint VM.
UCLASS.zh: 给编辑器和蓝图虚拟机用的元数据。

UINTERFACE.name: Blueprintable
UINTERFACE.doc: Interface can be implemented in Blueprints.

UINTERFACE.name: BlueprintType
UINTERFACE.doc: Interface can be used as a Blueprint variable type.

UINTERFACE.name: DependsOn
UINTERFACE.doc: UHT compiles the listed classes first.

UINTERFACE.name: MinimalAPI
UINTERFACE.doc: Exports only the type information from the module.

UINTERFACE.name: NotBlueprintable
UINTERFACE.doc: Interface cannot be implemented in Blueprints.

UINTERFACE.name: meta
UINTERFACE.doc: Metadata for the editor and Blueprint VM.

USTRUCT.name: Atomic
USTRUCT.doc: Struct is always serialized as a single unit.
USTRUCT.zh: 结构体总是作为一个整体序列化。

USTRUCT.name: BlueprintType
USTRUCT.doc: Struct can be used as a Blueprint variable type.
USTRUCT.zh: 可以在蓝图里作为变量类型。

USTRUCT.name: Immutable
USTRUCT.doc: Struct is atomic and cannot be changed in the Property editor (engine use).
USTRUCT.zh: 结构体是原子的，不能在属性编辑器里修改（引擎内部用）。

USTRUCT.name: NoExport
USTRUCT.doc: UHT does not generate the C++ declaration of the struct.
USTRUCT.zh: UHT 不生成这个结构体的 C++ 声明。

USTRUCT.name: meta
USTRUCT.doc: Metadata for the editor and Blueprint VM.
USTRUCT.zh: 给编辑器和蓝图虚拟机用的元数据。

UENUM.name: BlueprintType
UENUM.doc: Enum can be used as a Blueprint variable type.

UENUM.name: Flags
UENUM.doc: Enum is a bit-flag enum (use with meta=(Bitflags)).

UENUM.name: meta
UENUM.doc: Metadata for the editor and Blueprint VM.

UMETA.name: DisplayName
UMETA.doc: Name of the enum value shown in the editor.

UMETA.name: Hidden
UMETA.doc: Enum value is not shown in the editor.

UMETA.name: Grayed
UMETA.doc: Enum value is shown greyed out in drop-downs.

UPARAM.name: ref
UPARAM.doc: Reference parameter shown as an input pin (not an output) in Blueprints.

UPROPERTY.name: AdvancedDisplay
UPROPERTY.doc: Property is shown in the Advanced (collapsed) section of the Details panel.
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性显示在细节面板折叠的“高级”区。

UPROPERTY.name: AssetRegistrySearchable
UPROPERTY.doc: Property value is added to the asset registry as a searchable tag.
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性值作为可搜索标签加进资产注册表。

UPROPERTY.name: BlueprintAssignable
UPROPERTY.doc: Multicast delegate can be bound in Blueprints.
UPROPERTY.zh: 多播委托可以在蓝图里绑定。

UPROPERTY.name: BlueprintAuthorityOnly
UPROPERTY.doc: Multicast delegate only fires on the authority.
UPROPERTY.zh: 多播委托只在权威端（服务器）触发。

UPROPERTY.name: BlueprintCallable
UPROPERTY.doc: Multicast delegate can be called (Broadcast) from Blueprints.
UPROPERTY.zh: 多播委托可以在蓝图里调用（Broadcast）。

UPROPERTY.name: BlueprintGetter
UPROPERTY.doc: Blueprints read the property through this UFUNCTION.
UPROPERTY.zh: 蓝图通过这个 UFUNCTION 读取属性。

UPROPERTY.name: BlueprintReadOnly
UPROPERTY.doc: Property can be read but not written in Blueprints.
UPROPERTY.zh: 蓝图里只能读，不能写。

UPROPERTY.name: BlueprintReadWrite
UPROPERTY.doc: Property can be read and written in Blueprints.
UPROPERTY.zh: 蓝图里可读可写。

UPROPERTY.name: BlueprintSetter
UPROPERTY.doc: Blueprints write the property through this UFUNCTION.
UPROPERTY.zh: 蓝图通过这个 UFUNCTION 写入属性。

UPROPERTY.name: Category
UPROPERTY.doc: Category of the property in the Details panel and Blueprints ('|' nests).
UPROPERTY.zh: 在细节面板和蓝图里的分类（用 | 分层）。

UPROPERTY.name: Config
UPROPERTY.doc: Property is loaded from / saved to the class's config ini.
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性从类的配置 ini 读取 / 保存到那里。

UPROPERTY.name: Const
UPROPERTY.doc: Property is const in the editor and exported as const.
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性在编辑器里是 const，导出时也是 const。

UPROPERTY.name: DuplicateTransient
UPROPERTY.doc: Property is reset to default when the object is duplicated.
UPROPERTY.zh: 复制对象时属性重置为默认值。

UPROPERTY.name: EditAnywhere
UPROPERTY.doc: Editable in the Details panel of archetypes and instances.
UPROPERTY.zh: 原型（类默认值）和实例的细节面板里都能编辑。

UPROPERTY.name: EditDefaultsOnly
UPROPERTY.doc: Editable only on archetypes (class defaults).
UPROPERTY.zh: 只能在原型（类默认值）上编辑。

UPROPERTY.name: EditFixedSize
UPROPERTY.doc: Array size cannot be changed in the Details panel.
UPROPERTY.zh: 细节面板里不能改数组大小。

UPROPERTY.name: EditInline
UPROPERTY.doc: Object reference is edited inline in the Details panel.
UPROPERTY.zh: 对象引用在细节面板里内联编辑。

UPROPERTY.name: EditInstanceOnly
UPROPERTY.doc: Editable only on instances placed in a level.
UPROPERTY.zh: 只能在放进关卡的实例上编辑。

UPROPERTY.name: Export
UPROPERTY.doc: Assigned object is exported with its owner on copy / paste.
UPROPERTY.zh: 复制粘贴时，赋给的对象随所属对象一起导出。

UPROPERTY.name: FieldNotify
UPROPERTY.doc: Property broadcasts changes through the field notification system (MVVM).
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性变化通过字段通知系统广播（MVVM）。

UPROPERTY.name: Getter
UPROPERTY.doc: Native getter used by the property system.
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性系统用的原生 getter。

UPROPERTY.name: GlobalConfig
UPROPERTY.doc: Like Config but cannot be overridden by a subclass.
UPROPERTY.zh: 和 Config 一样，但子类不能覆盖。

UPROPERTY.name: Instanced
UPROPERTY.doc: Object property: each owner gets its own instance (implies EditInline, Export).
UPROPERTY.zh: 对象属性：每个所属对象有自己的实例（隐含 EditInline、Export）。

UPROPERTY.name: Interp
UPROPERTY.doc: Property can be animated by Sequencer / Matinee tracks.
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性可以被 Sequencer / Matinee 轨道驱动动画。

UPROPERTY.name: Localized
UPROPERTY.doc: Deprecated: value has a localized default.
UPROPERTY.zh: 已弃用：值有本地化的默认值。

UPROPERTY.name: NoClear
UPROPERTY.doc: Object reference cannot be set to None from the editor.
UPROPERTY.zh: 编辑器里不能把对象引用设为 None。

UPROPERTY.name: NonPIEDuplicateTransient
UPROPERTY.doc: Reset to default on duplicate except for Play In Editor.
UPROPERTY.zh: 复制时重置为默认值，PIE 除外。

UPROPERTY.name: NonTransactional
UPROPERTY.doc: Changes are not recorded in the undo history.
UPROPERTY.zh: 修改不记入撤销历史。

UPROPERTY.name: NotReplicated
UPROPERTY.doc: Struct member is not replicated (inside replicated structs).
UPROPERTY.zh: 结构体成员不复制（用在要复制的结构体里）。

UPROPERTY.name: Ref
UPROPERTY.doc: Function parameter passed by reference (Blueprint output pin).
UPROPERTY.zh: 函数参数按引用传递（蓝图输出引脚）。

UPROPERTY.name: Replicated
UPROPERTY.doc: Property is replicated over the network.
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性通过网络复制。

UPROPERTY.name: ReplicatedUsing
UPROPERTY.doc: Replicated; the given UFUNCTION is called on clients when the value arrives.
UPROPERTY.zh: 网络复制；值到达客户端时调用指定的 UFUNCTION。

UPROPERTY.name: RepRetry
UPROPERTY.doc: Deprecated: retry replication of the property when it fails.
UPROPERTY.zh: 已弃用：复制失败时重试。

UPROPERTY.name: SaveGame
UPROPERTY.doc: Property is serialized for save games (ArIsSaveGame).
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性随存档序列化（ArIsSaveGame）。

UPROPERTY.name: Setter
UPROPERTY.doc: Native setter used by the property system.
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性系统用的原生 setter。

UPROPERTY.name: SerializeText
UPROPERTY.doc: Native property serialized as text (ImportText / ExportText).
UPROPERTY.zh: 原生属性按文本序列化（ImportText / ExportText）。

UPROPERTY.name: SimpleDisplay
UPROPERTY.doc: Property is visible in the Details panel without expanding Advanced.
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性不用展开“高级”就显示在细节面板里。

UPROPERTY.name: SkipSerialization
UPROPERTY.doc: Property is not serialized but can still be exported to text.
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性不序列化，但仍可导出为文本。

UPROPERTY.name: TextExportTransient
UPROPERTY.doc: Property is not exported to text (copy / paste).
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性不导出为文本（复制粘贴）。

UPROPERTY.name: Transient
UPROPERTY.doc: Property is not saved and is zero-filled at load.
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性不保存，加载时清零。

UPROPERTY.name: VisibleAnywhere
UPROPERTY.doc: Visible (read-only) in the Details panel of archetypes and instances.
UPROPERTY.zh: 原型和实例的细节面板里都可见（只读）。

UPROPERTY.name: VisibleDefaultsOnly
UPROPERTY.doc: Visible only on archetypes.
UPROPERTY.zh: 只在原型上可见（只读）。

UPROPERTY.name: VisibleInstanceOnly
UPROPERTY.doc: Visible only on instances.
UPROPERTY.zh: 只在实例上可见（只读）。

UPROPERTY.name: meta
UPROPERTY.doc: Metadata for the editor and Blueprint VM.
UPROPERTY.zh: 给编辑器和蓝图虚拟机用的元数据。

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintAuthorityOnly
UFUNCTION.doc: Executes only on the authority (server) when called from Blueprints.
UFUNCTION.zh: 从蓝图调用时只在权威端（服务器）执行。

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintCallable
UFUNCTION.doc: Function can be called from Blueprints.
UFUNCTION.zh: 可以在蓝图里调用。

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintCosmetic
UFUNCTION.doc: Cosmetic function; does not run on dedicated servers.
UFUNCTION.zh: 表现用函数，专用服务器上不执行。

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintGetter
UFUNCTION.doc: Function is the Blueprint getter of a property.
UFUNCTION.zh: 这个函数是某个属性的蓝图 getter。

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintImplementableEvent
UFUNCTION.doc: Implemented in Blueprints; no C++ body.
UFUNCTION.zh: 在蓝图里实现，C++ 没有函数体。

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintNativeEvent
UFUNCTION.doc: Overridable in Blueprints; C++ default goes in Name_Implementation.
UFUNCTION.zh: 蓝图可重写；C++ 默认实现写在 Name_Implementation。

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintPure
UFUNCTION.doc: No side effects; Blueprint node has no exec pins (implies BlueprintCallable).
UFUNCTION.zh: 没有副作用，蓝图节点没有执行引脚（隐含 BlueprintCallable）。

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintSetter
UFUNCTION.doc: Function is the Blueprint setter of a property.
UFUNCTION.zh: 这个函数是某个属性的蓝图 setter。

UFUNCTION.name: CallInEditor
UFUNCTION.doc: Function can be called from a button in the Details panel.
UFUNCTION.zh: 可以在细节面板里点按钮调用。

UFUNCTION.name: Category
UFUNCTION.doc: Category of the function in the Blueprint action menu.
UFUNCTION.zh: 在蓝图动作菜单里的分类。

UFUNCTION.name: Client
UFUNCTION.doc: RPC executed on the owning client; implemented in Name_Implementation.
UFUNCTION.zh: 在拥有者客户端上执行的 RPC，实现写在 Name_Implementation。

UFUNCTION.name: CustomThunk
UFUNCTION.doc: UHT does not generate the execFoo thunk; you provide DECLARE_FUNCTION.
UFUNCTION.zh: UHT 不生成 execFoo 转接函数，由你写 DECLARE_FUNCTION。

UFUNCTION.name: Exec
UFUNCTION.doc: Function can be executed from the in-game console.
UFUNCTION.zh: 可以从游戏内控制台执行。

UFUNCTION.name: FieldNotify
UFUNCTION.doc: Function is a field-notify getter (MVVM).
UFUNCTION.zh: 函数是字段通知的 getter（MVVM）。

UFUNCTION.name: NetMulticast
UFUNCTION.doc: RPC executed on the server and all clients; implemented in Name_Implementation.
UFUNCTION.zh: 在服务器和所有客户端上执行的 RPC，实现写在 Name_Implementation。

UFUNCTION.name: Reliable
UFUNCTION.doc: RPC is guaranteed to arrive (ordered).
UFUNCTION.zh: RPC 保证送达（有序）。

UFUNCTION.name: SealedEvent
UFUNCTION.doc: Event cannot be overridden in subclasses.
UFUNCTION.zh: 事件不能在子类里重写。

UFUNCTION.name: Server
UFUNCTION.doc: RPC executed on the server; implemented in Name_Implementation.
UFUNCTION.zh: 在服务器上执行的 RPC，实现写在 Name_Implementation。

UFUNCTION.name: ServiceRequest
UFUNCTION.doc: Network service request RPC.
UFUNCTION.zh: 网络服务请求 RPC。

UFUNCTION.name: ServiceResponse
UFUNCTION.doc: Network service response RPC.
UFUNCTION.zh: 网络服务响应 RPC。

UFUNCTION.name: Unreliable
UFUNCTION.doc: RPC may be dropped under bandwidth pressure.
UFUNCTION.zh: 带宽紧张时 RPC 可能被丢弃。

UFUNCTION.name: WithValidation
UFUNCTION.doc: RPC has a Name_Validate function that can reject the call.
UFUNCTION.zh: RPC 有 Name_Validate 函数，可以拒绝这次调用。

UFUNCTION.name: meta
UFUNCTION.doc: Metadata for the editor and Blueprint VM.
UFUNCTION.zh: 给编辑器和蓝图虚拟机用的元数据。

UCLASS.name: DisplayName
UCLASS.doc: Name shown in the editor instead of the code name.
UCLASS.zh: 编辑器里显示的名字（代替代码里的名字）。

UCLASS.name: ToolTip
UCLASS.doc: Tooltip text (overrides the doc comment).
UCLASS.zh: 提示文字（覆盖文档注释）。

UCLASS.name: ShortToolTip
UCLASS.doc: Short tooltip used in class pickers and menus.
UCLASS.zh: 类选择器和菜单里用的简短提示。

UCLASS.name: DeprecationMessage
UCLASS.doc: Message shown when a deprecated item is used.
UCLASS.zh: 使用已弃用的项时显示的消息。

UCLASS.name: BlueprintSpawnableComponent
UCLASS.doc: Component class appears in the Add Component list of Blueprints.
UCLASS.zh: 组件类出现在蓝图的“添加组件”列表里。

UCLASS.name: BlueprintThreadSafe
UCLASS.doc: Functions of this (function library) class can run on worker threads.
UCLASS.zh: 这个（函数库）类的函数可以在工作线程上运行。

UCLASS.name: ChildCannotTick
UCLASS.doc: Blueprint subclasses of this actor / component cannot tick.
UCLASS.zh: 这个 Actor / 组件的蓝图子类不能 Tick。

UCLASS.name: ChildCanTick
UCLASS.doc: Blueprint subclasses may tick even if the native class disables ticking.
UCLASS.zh: 即使原生类关掉了 Tick，蓝图子类也可以 Tick。

UCLASS.name: DeprecatedNode
UCLASS.doc: Node class is deprecated (behavior tree / K2 nodes).
UCLASS.zh: 节点类已弃用（行为树 / K2 节点）。

UCLASS.name: DontUseGenericSpawnObject
UCLASS.doc: Class is not spawned by the generic Construct Object node.
UCLASS.zh: 不通过通用的 Construct Object 节点生成。

UCLASS.name: ExposedAsyncProxy
UCLASS.doc: Async action class exposes its proxy object in the node.
UCLASS.zh: 异步动作类在节点上暴露它的代理对象。

UCLASS.name: IgnoreCategoryKeywordsInSubclasses
UCLASS.doc: Subclasses do not inherit ShowCategories / HideCategories.
UCLASS.zh: 子类不继承 ShowCategories / HideCategories。

UCLASS.name: IsBlueprintBase
UCLASS.doc: Class can (true) or cannot (false) be a Blueprint base.
UCLASS.zh: 类能（true）或不能（false）作为蓝图父类。

UCLASS.name: KismetHideOverrides
UCLASS.doc: Blueprint events that cannot be overridden.
UCLASS.zh: 不能被重写的蓝图事件。

UCLASS.name: PrioritizeCategories
UCLASS.doc: Categories listed first in the Details panel.
UCLASS.zh: 细节面板里排在最前的分类。

UCLASS.name: ProhibitedInterfaces
UCLASS.doc: Interfaces that Blueprints of this class may not implement.
UCLASS.zh: 这个类的蓝图不能实现的接口。

UCLASS.name: RestrictedToClasses
UCLASS.doc: Function library nodes are only available in these classes.
UCLASS.zh: 函数库节点只在这些类里可用。

UCLASS.name: ShowWorldContextPin
UCLASS.doc: Shows the world context pin on nodes of this class.
UCLASS.zh: 这个类的节点显示世界上下文引脚。

UCLASS.name: UsesHierarchy
UCLASS.doc: Class uses a hierarchy (shows the hierarchy view).
UCLASS.zh: 类使用层级（显示层级视图）。

UINTERFACE.name: DisplayName
UINTERFACE.doc: Name shown in the editor instead of the code name.

UINTERFACE.name: ShortToolTip
UINTERFACE.doc: Short tooltip used in class pickers and menus.

UINTERFACE.name: DeprecationMessage
UINTERFACE.doc: Message shown when a deprecated item is used.

UINTERFACE.name: CannotImplementInterfaceInBlueprint
UINTERFACE.doc: Interface cannot be implemented by Blueprints (only C++).

UINTERFACE.name: IsBlueprintBase
UINTERFACE.doc: Interface can be a Blueprint base.

USTRUCT.name: DisplayName
USTRUCT.doc: Name shown in the editor instead of the code name.
USTRUCT.zh: 编辑器里显示的名字（代替代码里的名字）。

USTRUCT.name: ToolTip
USTRUCT.zh: 提示文字（覆盖文档注释）。

USTRUCT.name: ShortToolTip
USTRUCT.doc: Short tooltip used in class pickers and menus.
USTRUCT.zh: 类选择器和菜单里用的简短提示。

USTRUCT.name: DeprecationMessage
USTRUCT.doc: Message shown when a deprecated item is used.
USTRUCT.zh: 使用已弃用的项时显示的消息。

USTRUCT.name: BlueprintInternalUseOnly
USTRUCT.doc: Struct is hidden from Blueprint users.
USTRUCT.zh: 结构体对蓝图用户隐藏。

USTRUCT.name: HasNativeBreak
USTRUCT.doc: Native UFUNCTION used as the Break node.
USTRUCT.zh: 用作 Break 节点的原生 UFUNCTION。

USTRUCT.name: HasNativeMake
USTRUCT.doc: Native UFUNCTION used as the Make node.
USTRUCT.zh: 用作 Make 节点的原生 UFUNCTION。

USTRUCT.name: HiddenByDefault
USTRUCT.doc: Make / Break nodes hide all pins by default.
USTRUCT.zh: Make / Break 节点默认隐藏所有引脚。

USTRUCT.name: DisableSplitPin
USTRUCT.doc: Struct pins cannot be split in Blueprints.
USTRUCT.zh: 蓝图里不能拆分这个结构体的引脚。

UENUM.name: DisplayName
UENUM.doc: Name shown in the editor instead of the code name.

UENUM.name: ShortToolTip
UENUM.doc: Short tooltip used in class pickers and menus.

UENUM.name: DeprecationMessage
UENUM.doc: Message shown when a deprecated item is used.

UENUM.name: Bitflags
UENUM.doc: Enum values are bit flags (used with UPROPERTY meta=(Bitmask, BitmaskEnum)).

UENUM.name: UseEnumValuesAsMaskValuesInEditor
UENUM.doc: Enum values are already masks (1, 2, 4...) rather than bit indices.

UPARAM.name: DisplayName
UPARAM.doc: Name shown in the editor instead of the code name.

UPARAM.name: ShortToolTip
UPARAM.doc: Short tooltip used in class pickers and menus.

UPARAM.name: DeprecationMessage
UPARAM.doc: Message shown when a deprecated item is used.

UPROPERTY.name: DisplayName
UPROPERTY.doc: Name shown in the editor instead of the code name.
UPROPERTY.zh: 编辑器里显示的名字（代替代码里的名字）。

UPROPERTY.name: ToolTip
UPROPERTY.doc: Tooltip text (overrides the doc comment).
UPROPERTY.zh: 提示文字（覆盖文档注释）。

UPROPERTY.name: ShortToolTip
UPROPERTY.doc: Short tooltip used in class pickers and menus.
UPROPERTY.zh: 类选择器和菜单里用的简短提示。

UPROPERTY.name: DeprecationMessage
UPROPERTY.doc: Message shown when a deprecated item is used.
UPROPERTY.zh: 使用已弃用的项时显示的消息。

UPROPERTY.name: AllowAbstract
UPROPERTY.doc: Class / soft class pickers include abstract classes.
UPROPERTY.zh: 类 / 软类选择器里也列出抽象类。

UPROPERTY.name: AllowedClasses
UPROPERTY.doc: Asset pickers only accept these classes.
UPROPERTY.zh: 资产选择器只接受这些类。

UPROPERTY.name: AllowPreserveRatio
UPROPERTY.doc: Vector property shows a lock for preserving the ratio.
UPROPERTY.zh: 向量属性显示保持比例的锁。

UPROPERTY.name: AllowPrivateAccess
UPROPERTY.doc: Private member can be exposed to Blueprints (BlueprintReadOnly / ReadWrite).
UPROPERTY.zh: 私有成员也能暴露给蓝图（BlueprintReadOnly / ReadWrite）。

UPROPERTY.name: ArrayClamp
UPROPERTY.doc: Integer is clamped to the valid indices of the named array.
UPROPERTY.zh: 整数被限制在指定数组的有效下标范围内。

UPROPERTY.name: AssetBundles
UPROPERTY.doc: Asset bundle(s) the soft reference belongs to.
UPROPERTY.zh: 软引用所属的资产包。

UPROPERTY.name: Bitmask
UPROPERTY.doc: Integer property is edited as a bit mask.
UPROPERTY.zh: 整数属性按位掩码编辑。

UPROPERTY.name: BitmaskEnum
UPROPERTY.doc: Enum that names the bits of a Bitmask property.
UPROPERTY.zh: 给 Bitmask 属性的各位命名的枚举。

UPROPERTY.name: BlueprintBaseOnly
UPROPERTY.doc: Class pickers only show Blueprint base classes.
UPROPERTY.zh: 类选择器只显示可作蓝图父类的类。

UPROPERTY.name: Categories
UPROPERTY.doc: GameplayTag(Container) property only offers tags below this root.
UPROPERTY.zh: GameplayTag(Container) 属性只提供这个根下的标签。

UPROPERTY.name: ClampMax
UPROPERTY.doc: Maximum value accepted by the editor.
UPROPERTY.zh: 编辑器接受的最大值。

UPROPERTY.name: ClampMin
UPROPERTY.doc: Minimum value accepted by the editor.
UPROPERTY.zh: 编辑器接受的最小值。

UPROPERTY.name: ContentDir
UPROPERTY.doc: Directory picker is relative to the content directory.
UPROPERTY.zh: 目录选择器相对于 Content 目录。

UPROPERTY.name: Delta
UPROPERTY.doc: Step used by the slider / spin box.
UPROPERTY.zh: 滑块 / 微调框的步长。

UPROPERTY.name: DisplayAfter
UPROPERTY.doc: Shows the property after the named one.
UPROPERTY.zh: 显示在指定属性之后。

UPROPERTY.name: DisplayPriority
UPROPERTY.doc: Order of the property within its category.
UPROPERTY.zh: 在分类里的排序。

UPROPERTY.name: DisplayThumbnail
UPROPERTY.doc: Shows (true) or hides (false) the asset thumbnail.
UPROPERTY.zh: 显示（true）或隐藏（false）资产缩略图。

UPROPERTY.name: EditCondition
UPROPERTY.doc: Property is editable only when the condition is true.
UPROPERTY.zh: 条件为真时才能编辑。

UPROPERTY.name: EditConditionHides
UPROPERTY.doc: Property is hidden (not just disabled) when EditCondition is false.
UPROPERTY.zh: EditCondition 为假时隐藏（不只是置灰）。

UPROPERTY.name: EditFixedOrder
UPROPERTY.doc: Array elements cannot be reordered.
UPROPERTY.zh: 数组元素不能调整顺序。

UPROPERTY.name: ExactClass
UPROPERTY.doc: Asset picker only accepts exactly AllowedClasses (no subclasses).
UPROPERTY.zh: 资产选择器只接受 AllowedClasses 本身（不含子类）。

UPROPERTY.name: ExposeFunctionCategories
UPROPERTY.doc: Functions of the component in these categories are exposed on the owner.
UPROPERTY.zh: 组件里这些分类的函数暴露到所属对象上。

UPROPERTY.name: ExposeOnSpawn
UPROPERTY.doc: Property is a pin on Spawn Actor / Construct Object nodes.
UPROPERTY.zh: 属性作为 Spawn Actor / Construct Object 节点的引脚。

UPROPERTY.name: FilePathFilter
UPROPERTY.doc: File picker filter.
UPROPERTY.zh: 文件选择器的过滤器。

UPROPERTY.name: ForceInlineRow
UPROPERTY.doc: Struct / map value is shown in a single row.
UPROPERTY.zh: 结构体 / Map 值显示在一行里。

UPROPERTY.name: ForceUnits
UPROPERTY.doc: Units of the value; the editor does not convert.
UPROPERTY.zh: 值的单位，编辑器不换算。

UPROPERTY.name: GetByRef
UPROPERTY.doc: Blueprint getter returns the property by reference.
UPROPERTY.zh: 蓝图 getter 按引用返回属性。

UPROPERTY.name: GetOptions
UPROPERTY.doc: UFUNCTION returning the allowed values (FName / FString drop-down).
UPROPERTY.zh: 返回可选值的 UFUNCTION（FName / FString 下拉框）。

UPROPERTY.name: HideAlphaChannel
UPROPERTY.doc: Colour property hides the alpha channel.
UPROPERTY.zh: 颜色属性隐藏 Alpha 通道。

UPROPERTY.name: HideInDetailPanel
UPROPERTY.doc: Delegate property is hidden in the Details panel.
UPROPERTY.zh: 委托属性在细节面板里隐藏。

UPROPERTY.name: HideViewOptions
UPROPERTY.doc: Hides the view options of a class / asset picker.
UPROPERTY.zh: 隐藏类 / 资产选择器的视图选项。

UPROPERTY.name: InlineEditConditionToggle
UPROPERTY.doc: Bool property is shown inline as the EditCondition checkbox of another property.
UPROPERTY.zh: bool 属性作为另一个属性的 EditCondition 勾选框内联显示。

UPROPERTY.name: InvalidEnumValues
UPROPERTY.doc: Enum values not offered in the drop-down.
UPROPERTY.zh: 下拉框里不提供的枚举值。

UPROPERTY.name: LinearDeltaSensitivity
UPROPERTY.doc: Slider sensitivity for linear deltas.
UPROPERTY.zh: 线性拖动时滑块的灵敏度。

UPROPERTY.name: LongPackageName
UPROPERTY.doc: Directory picker returns a long package name.
UPROPERTY.zh: 目录选择器返回长包名。

UPROPERTY.name: MakeEditWidget
UPROPERTY.doc: Vector / transform shows a 3D widget in the viewport.
UPROPERTY.zh: 向量 / 变换在视口里显示 3D 控件。

UPROPERTY.name: MaxPropertyDepth
UPROPERTY.doc: Maximum depth shown for nested instanced objects.
UPROPERTY.zh: 嵌套实例化对象最多显示几层。

UPROPERTY.name: MetaClass
UPROPERTY.doc: Base class for FSoftClassPath / FStringClassReference pickers.
UPROPERTY.zh: FSoftClassPath / FStringClassReference 选择器的基类。

UPROPERTY.name: MultiLine
UPROPERTY.doc: Text property is edited in a multi-line box.
UPROPERTY.zh: 文本属性用多行输入框编辑。

UPROPERTY.name: MustImplement
UPROPERTY.doc: Class picker only accepts classes implementing this interface.
UPROPERTY.zh: 类选择器只接受实现了这个接口的类。

UPROPERTY.name: NoElementDuplicate
UPROPERTY.doc: Array elements cannot be duplicated in the Details panel.
UPROPERTY.zh: 细节面板里不能复制数组元素。

UPROPERTY.name: NoResetToDefault
UPROPERTY.doc: Hides the reset-to-default arrow.
UPROPERTY.zh: 隐藏“重置为默认值”箭头。

UPROPERTY.name: PasswordField
UPROPERTY.doc: Text is shown as a password field.
UPROPERTY.zh: 文本显示为密码框。

UPROPERTY.name: ReadOnlyKeys
UPROPERTY.doc: Map keys cannot be edited.
UPROPERTY.zh: Map 的键不能编辑。

UPROPERTY.name: RelativePath
UPROPERTY.doc: Directory picker returns a path relative to the project.
UPROPERTY.zh: 目录选择器返回相对项目的路径。

UPROPERTY.name: RelativeToGameContentDir
UPROPERTY.doc: Directory picker is relative to the game content directory.
UPROPERTY.zh: 目录选择器相对于游戏 Content 目录。

UPROPERTY.name: ShowOnlyInnerProperties
UPROPERTY.doc: Struct property shows its members without a header row.
UPROPERTY.zh: 结构体属性只显示成员，不显示标题行。

UPROPERTY.name: ShowTreeView
UPROPERTY.doc: Class picker shows a tree view.
UPROPERTY.zh: 类选择器显示树形视图。

UPROPERTY.name: SliderExponent
UPROPERTY.doc: Exponent of the slider curve.
UPROPERTY.zh: 滑块曲线的指数。

UPROPERTY.name: TitleProperty
UPROPERTY.doc: Array of structs uses this member (or format) as element title.
UPROPERTY.zh: 结构体数组用这个成员（或格式）作为元素标题。

UPROPERTY.name: UIMax
UPROPERTY.doc: Maximum value of the slider (typed values may exceed it).
UPROPERTY.zh: 滑块最大值（手动输入可以超过）。

UPROPERTY.name: UIMin
UPROPERTY.doc: Minimum value of the slider.
UPROPERTY.zh: 滑块最小值。

UPROPERTY.name: Units
UPROPERTY.doc: Units of the value, converted for display.
UPROPERTY.zh: 值的单位，显示时会换算。

UPROPERTY.name: ValidEnumValues
UPROPERTY.doc: Only these enum values are offered in the drop-down.
UPROPERTY.zh: 下拉框里只提供这些枚举值。

UFUNCTION.name: DisplayName
UFUNCTION.doc: Name shown in the editor instead of the code name.
UFUNCTION.zh: 编辑器里显示的名字（代替代码里的名字）。

UFUNCTION.name: ToolTip
UFUNCTION.doc: Tooltip text (overrides the doc comment).
UFUNCTION.zh: 提示文字（覆盖文档注释）。

UFUNCTION.name: ShortToolTip
UFUNCTION.doc: Short tooltip used in class pickers and menus.
UFUNCTION.zh: 类选择器和菜单里用的简短提示。

UFUNCTION.name: DeprecationMessage
UFUNCTION.doc: Message shown when a deprecated item is used.
UFUNCTION.zh: 使用已弃用的项时显示的消息。

UFUNCTION.name: AdvancedDisplay
UFUNCTION.doc: Parameters shown under the advanced arrow of the node.
UFUNCTION.zh: 显示在节点“高级”箭头下的参数。

UFUNCTION.name: ArrayParm
UFUNCTION.doc: Parameters that are wildcard arrays.
UFUNCTION.zh: 通配数组参数。

UFUNCTION.name: ArrayTypeDependentParams
UFUNCTION.doc: Parameters whose type follows the ArrayParm.
UFUNCTION.zh: 类型跟随 ArrayParm 的参数。

UFUNCTION.name: AutoCreateRefTerm
UFUNCTION.doc: Reference parameters that get a default value when unconnected.
UFUNCTION.zh: 未连接时自动给默认值的引用参数。

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintAutocast
UFUNCTION.doc: Pure static function is used as an automatic cast node.
UFUNCTION.zh: 纯静态函数用作自动转换节点。

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintInternalUseOnly
UFUNCTION.doc: Function is hidden from Blueprint users.
UFUNCTION.zh: 函数对蓝图用户隐藏。

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintProtected
UFUNCTION.doc: Function can only be called on self in Blueprints.
UFUNCTION.zh: 蓝图里只能在自身上调用。

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintThreadSafe
UFUNCTION.doc: Function can run on worker threads (animation graphs).
UFUNCTION.zh: 函数可以在工作线程上运行（动画图表）。

UFUNCTION.name: CallableWithoutWorldContext
UFUNCTION.doc: Function can be called in Blueprints without a world context.
UFUNCTION.zh: 蓝图里不需要世界上下文也能调用。

UFUNCTION.name: CommutativeAssociativeBinaryOperator
UFUNCTION.doc: Node gets an Add Pin button (A op B op C...).
UFUNCTION.zh: 节点有“添加引脚”按钮（A op B op C…）。

UFUNCTION.name: CompactNodeTitle
UFUNCTION.doc: Node is drawn in compact form with this title.
UFUNCTION.zh: 节点用紧凑样式显示，标题为这个文字。

UFUNCTION.name: CustomStructureParam
UFUNCTION.doc: Parameters that are wildcard structs (CustomThunk).
UFUNCTION.zh: 通配结构体参数（CustomThunk）。

UFUNCTION.name: DefaultToSelf
UFUNCTION.doc: Parameter defaults to self when unconnected.
UFUNCTION.zh: 参数未连接时默认是 self。

UFUNCTION.name: DeprecatedFunction
UFUNCTION.doc: Function is deprecated; Blueprint compile warns.
UFUNCTION.zh: 函数已弃用，蓝图编译时警告。

UFUNCTION.name: DeterminesOutputType
UFUNCTION.doc: Return type follows the class passed in this parameter.
UFUNCTION.zh: 返回类型跟随这个参数传入的类。

UFUNCTION.name: DevelopmentOnly
UFUNCTION.doc: Function is only executed in development builds.
UFUNCTION.zh: 函数只在开发版本里执行。

UFUNCTION.name: DynamicOutputParam
UFUNCTION.doc: Output parameter whose type follows DeterminesOutputType.
UFUNCTION.zh: 类型跟随 DeterminesOutputType 的输出参数。

UFUNCTION.name: ExpandBoolAsExecs
UFUNCTION.doc: Bool parameter / return value becomes exec pins.
UFUNCTION.zh: bool 参数 / 返回值变成执行引脚。

UFUNCTION.name: ExpandEnumAsExecs
UFUNCTION.doc: Enum parameter becomes one exec pin per value.
UFUNCTION.zh: 枚举参数的每个值变成一个执行引脚。

UFUNCTION.name: HidePin
UFUNCTION.doc: Parameter pin is hidden.
UFUNCTION.zh: 隐藏这个参数的引脚。

UFUNCTION.name: HideSelfPin
UFUNCTION.doc: Hides the self (target) pin.
UFUNCTION.zh: 隐藏 self（目标）引脚。

UFUNCTION.name: HideSpawnParms
UFUNCTION.doc: Hides spawn parameters on the node.
UFUNCTION.zh: 在节点上隐藏生成参数。

UFUNCTION.name: Keywords
UFUNCTION.doc: Extra search keywords for the action menu.
UFUNCTION.zh: 动作菜单的额外搜索关键词。

UFUNCTION.name: Latent
UFUNCTION.doc: Latent action (needs LatentInfo).
UFUNCTION.zh: 延迟动作（需要 LatentInfo）。

UFUNCTION.name: LatentInfo
UFUNCTION.doc: Parameter that receives the FLatentActionInfo.
UFUNCTION.zh: 接收 FLatentActionInfo 的参数。

UFUNCTION.name: MaterialParameterCollectionFunction
UFUNCTION.doc: Function takes a material parameter collection (name validation).
UFUNCTION.zh: 函数接收材质参数集（做名字校验）。

UFUNCTION.name: NativeBreakFunc
UFUNCTION.doc: Function is the native Break of a struct.
UFUNCTION.zh: 函数是结构体的原生 Break。

UFUNCTION.name: NativeMakeFunc
UFUNCTION.doc: Function is the native Make of a struct.
UFUNCTION.zh: 函数是结构体的原生 Make。

UFUNCTION.name: NotBlueprintThreadSafe
UFUNCTION.doc: Function is not thread safe inside a BlueprintThreadSafe library.
UFUNCTION.zh: 在 BlueprintThreadSafe 函数库里标明这个函数不是线程安全的。

UFUNCTION.name: ReturnDisplayName
UFUNCTION.doc: Name of the return value pin.
UFUNCTION.zh: 返回值引脚的名字。

UFUNCTION.name: ScriptMethod
UFUNCTION.doc: Exposed to Python as a method of the first parameter's type.
UFUNCTION.zh: 作为第一个参数类型的方法暴露给 Python。

UFUNCTION.name: ScriptName
UFUNCTION.doc: Name used by scripting (Python).
UFUNCTION.zh: 脚本（Python）里用的名字。

UFUNCTION.name: ScriptOperator
UFUNCTION.doc: Exposed to Python as an operator.
UFUNCTION.zh: 作为运算符暴露给 Python。

UFUNCTION.name: UnsafeDuringActorConstruction
UFUNCTION.doc: Function cannot be called from a construction script.
UFUNCTION.zh: 不能在构造脚本里调用。

UFUNCTION.name: WorldContext
UFUNCTION.doc: Parameter that provides the world context.
UFUNCTION.zh: 提供世界上下文的参数。

UDELEGATE.name: DisplayName
UDELEGATE.doc: Name shown in the editor instead of the code name.

UDELEGATE.name: ShortToolTip
UDELEGATE.doc: Short tooltip used in class pickers and menus.

UDELEGATE.name: DeprecationMessage
UDELEGATE.doc: Message shown when a deprecated item is used.
